facts.text: Dinner in a quiet tank with no crowds and no touch pool, that is all I want tonight. Pass the shrimp and nobody poke me.
facts.why: The moviemistakes quote list has Hank's real lines (such as 'Holy carp.') and not this one. As a note it suits Hank, who wants a quiet life and to avoid the ocean, but it is printed in quote marks.
facts.fix: Use a note: A quiet tank, no crowds, no ocean. That is all I want tonight. Pass the shrimp and nobody poke me.
